name: Claude Mem
description: Install claude-mem and configure it to capture Claude Code/Codex session memory.

version.description: Enter a claude-mem npm version (e.g. '13.24.0'), or use 'latest'.

ide.description: Comma-separated IDE integrations to register: claude-code and/or codex-cli.

provider.description: Memory LLM provider: claude requires Claude Code CLI/login; codex requires Codex CLI/login; host requires your own local compatible server. by-source routes Claude Code sessions to claude and Codex sessions to codex, with claude as the default (requires both CLIs/logins).
